fields.name: work_area_low
fields.meaning: Not save data: working space (on-screen text buffers are drawn at 0x1602 onward). Never checksummed or read back at power-on
fields.evidence: code 2000:25B3A/25F0E draw text into 0x1602; outside checksum range; boot reads nothing here

fields.name: signature_1
fields.meaning: Fixed text WANDER SWAN WIZ1. Checked at power-on; if either signature is missing the whole memory is wiped and a new roster is made
fields.evidence: code 2000:4A60 compares against ROM 2000:4B49; boot reads at 2000:4A71

fields.name: roster
fields.meaning: Character roster: 20 records of 0x6F (111) bytes, record n at 0x2FC2 + n*0x6F. A fresh memory holds 6 ready-made characters; records 6-19 stay zero until characters are created. There is no save command: the game edits these records directly in place
fields.evidence: code 2000:4B74 builds defaults with stride 0x6F; 2000:25B3A/20B98 walk the roster with stride 0x6F; diffs across full play history

fields.name: rec.name
fields.meaning: Character name as font tiles: 0x02 prefix, tile bytes, 0xFF end. Tiles: 00 space, 01-0A digits 0-9, 0B-24 A-Z, 30-5D hiragana, 5E-66 small hiragana, 68-70 small katakana, 71-9C katakana, 9D katakana N, 9E dakuten, 9F handakuten, plus punctuation
fields.evidence: code 9000:0501 copies bytes raw after 0x02 until 0xFF; ROM names 2000:4E84; tile table decoded from text buffers matched to screenshots

fields.name: rec.level
fields.meaning: Character level
fields.evidence: code 2000:25F0E prints it; 7000:2FBB/30B1/3182/3210 use it for saves, AC, to-hit, attacks; reset to 1 on class change 3000:34AD

fields.name: rec.unknown_0c
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: scan of all 177 save images (always 0); no verified code use

fields.name: rec.hp
fields.meaning: Current hit points
fields.evidence: code 2000:25B3A prints +0x0E as HP; set from ROM table by 2000:4B74; matches screen

fields.name: rec.hp_max
fields.meaning: Maximum hit points (a status word is shown instead unless status&0x1FC==0)
fields.evidence: code 2000:25B3A prints +0x10 as max HP

fields.name: rec.ac_base
fields.meaning: Base armour class 10 (for a ninja, computed from level)
fields.evidence: code 7000:30B1 writes 10 (or the ninja formula)

fields.name: rec.ac_mods
fields.meaning: Two temporary armour-class adjustments (battle spell effects). Shown AC = ac + mod1 + mod2; both are cleared at every power-on
fields.evidence: code 2000:25B3A shows the sum; 2000:4DCB zeroes both at boot; always 0 in saves

fields.name: rec.ac
fields.meaning: Armour class with worn equipment. Recomputed from the base value and worn items whenever equipment changes
fields.evidence: code 7000:30B1; equip/unequip diffs (4<->10); verified natural save shows 10 vs default 4

fields.name: rec.stats
fields.meaning: Six attributes in screen order: strength, IQ, piety, vitality, agility, luck
fields.evidence: code 2000:4B74 copies from ROM table; 7000:3182 uses strength for to-hit, 7000:2FBB uses luck for saves; bytes match status page

fields.name: rec.alignment
fields.meaning: Alignment: 0 good, 1 neutral, 2 evil
fields.evidence: code 2000:26058 picks the G/N/E text from ROM table 2000:60A1

fields.name: rec.age
fields.meaning: Age in years (gains 5 on a class change, 1 per 365 day-counter days, capped at 255)
fields.evidence: code 2000:4B74 defaults; 2000:1260 aging; 3000:34B3 class change; matches screen

fields.name: rec.race
fields.meaning: Race: 0 human, 1 elf, 2 dwarf, 3 gnome, 4 hobbit
fields.evidence: ROM name tables 2000:60E0 (Japanese) / 60D4 set (English); 7000:2FBB race save bonus

fields.name: rec.class
fields.meaning: Class: 0 fighter, 1 mage, 2 priest, 3 thief, 4 bishop, 5 samurai, 6 lord, 7 ninja
fields.evidence: ROM text table 2000:60AD (FI/MA/PR/TH/BI/SA/LO/NI); class branches in 7000 code; init gives spells by class

fields.name: rec.saves
fields.meaning: Five saving throws (lower is better): 20 - level/5 - luck/6, clamped to 1-16, adjusted by class and race tables
fields.evidence: code 7000:2FBB with tables 7000:3052/308A

fields.name: rec.item_props
fields.meaning: Special-property bits ORed together from carried items (worn items contribute more bits)
fields.evidence: code 7000:3210 ORs item-data word +0x10 with masks 0x9FE0/0x9F00; always 0 in saves

fields.name: rec.attacks
fields.meaning: Attacks per round from class and level; a weapon can raise it
fields.evidence: code 7000:3210 writes it; 1 for all level-1 characters; battle use not traced

fields.name: rec.to_hit
fields.meaning: To-hit bonus from class, level, strength and the worn weapon
fields.evidence: code 7000:3182/3210; diff 5->1 when the long sword was removed

fields.name: rec.regen
fields.meaning: Sum of the healing (positive) or draining (negative) values of carried items; + or - is shown by HP when nonzero
fields.evidence: code 7000:332D sums item data +6; 2000:25B3A shows the mark; always 0 in saves

fields.name: rec.dmg_p0
fields.meaning: Damage parameter, always 2 (weapons do not change it); role not resolved
fields.evidence: code 7000:2F6C writes 2; battle use not traced

fields.name: rec.dmg_spread
fields.meaning: Damage spread (maximum minus minimum): 2 bare-handed, weapon max-min when armed
fields.evidence: code 7000:2F6C/3210; long sword (1-8) gives 7

fields.name: rec.dmg_min
fields.meaning: Damage minimum plus strength bonus (strength-15 when strength >= 16)
fields.evidence: code 7000:3182/3210; long sword gives 1

fields.name: rec.critical
fields.meaning: 1 when the character can land critical hits: ninja, or items 86/106 worn; a cursed worn item clears it
fields.evidence: code 7000:2F6C/30B1/3210; always 0 in saves (no ninja, no such items)

fields.name: rec.maze_slot
fields.meaning: Maze-party slot key, matched against the maze slot flags at 0x3BDE
fields.evidence: code 2000:21009 cleanup, 2000:0CF6 slot allocator, maze-bank collector; always 0 (no maze trip in saves)

fields.name: rec.item_count
fields.meaning: Number of items carried (0-8); only that many item slots are valid
fields.evidence: code 7000:2DD2/30B1/3210 loop over this many slots; drop diff 3->2

fields.name: rec.mage_spells
fields.meaning: Mage spells: 7 circles x u16. Low byte = bitmask of known spells in the circle; high byte = spell-points nibble pair (equal at rest)
fields.evidence: code 3000:28C9 creation table (mask + points by IQ), 3000:34BF popcount rewrite on class change; defaults 01 11

fields.name: rec.priest_spells
fields.meaning: Priest spells: same 7-circle layout as mage spells
fields.evidence: code 3000:28DC creation by piety, 3000:34BF rewrite; default 02 11

fields.name: rec.items
fields.meaning: Up to 8 items, 2 bytes each: item number, then flags. Flag 0x02 = worn (only worn items count for AC/weapon and show * on the status page); 0x04 likely cursed; 0x01 always set, meaning unknown
fields.evidence: code 7000:30B1/3210/2DD2 test word bits 0x200/0x400; equip diffs 03<->01; verified save (only the long sword worn)

fields.name: rec.status
fields.meaning: Condition flags. 0 = healthy. Bits 0x40 dead, 0x80 ashes, 0x100 lost (status words DEAD/ASHE/LOST, or OUT/D-O/A-O/L-O variants when bit 0 is set); bit 0 = away from the castle, likely in the maze; other bits unknown
fields.evidence: code 2000:25F0E/25B3A/20B98 + ROM word table 2000:6127; 0 in all saves

fields.name: rec.exp
fields.meaning: Experience points, shown as E.P.
fields.evidence: code 2000:61DD prints the 48-bit value; 3000:349B zeroes it on class change; level 2 needs 1000 on screen; always 0 (no battles fought)

fields.name: rec.gold
fields.meaning: Gold carried, shown as G.P., capped at 999999999999
fields.evidence: code 2000:6520 prints it, 2000:0CB7 adds with saturation cap, 3000:4512 pools party gold; always 0

fields.name: rec.age_days
fields.meaning: Elapsed-day counter toward aging; every 365 rolls into +1 age
fields.evidence: code 2000:1260 adds days and ages at 365; inn-stay diff 0->3

fields.name: rec.unknown_6b
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: scan of all 177 save images; no code refs found

fields.name: options
fields.meaning: Options/flags word, copied to RAM at power-on. Bit 0 = English (vs Japanese) race names; other tested bits (1,2,4,5,6,7,8) and event-set bits 14-15 have unknown roles
fields.evidence: code 2000:25F0E switches race tables by bit 0; ROM scan finds bit tests; setters 3000:3D5D (bit15), maze bank (bit14); always 0

fields.name: shop_stock
fields.meaning: Shop stock, one byte per item number: 0xFF = unlimited, else count left
fields.evidence: code 2000:4C90 fills it from ROM pairs at 2000:4CBC; never changes in saves (nothing bought/sold)

fields.name: unknown_38eb
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: scan of all 177 save images

fields.name: counters_38ec
fields.meaning: Event counters, u16 each, capped at 9999; possibly monsters killed per type
fields.evidence: code 2000:123E increments words here from an encounter list; always 0; no display traced

fields.name: roster_count
fields.meaning: Number of characters in the roster (6 on a fresh memory)
fields.evidence: code 2000:4B74 writes 6; 2000:20B98/020ACF walk and adjust it

fields.name: message_speed
fields.meaning: Message speed 0-9 (9 = fastest, the default); a menu choice writes it
fields.evidence: code 3000:0C0E stores a menu pick; readers 3000:00B5/8B1F index delay tables by it

fields.name: maze_slots
fields.meaning: 20 slot flags (one per roster slot), nonzero while a party member is away in the maze
fields.evidence: code 2000:0CF6 allocates (0xFF), 2000:21009 clears stale entries vs rec.maze_slot; always 0

fields.name: unknown_3bf2
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: scan of all 177 save images; no code refs found

fields.name: list_40f4
fields.meaning: Ten bytes 0x0A-0x13 on a fresh memory; meaning not resolved
fields.evidence: code 2000:4A60 format loop; no readers found

fields.name: unknown_40fe
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: scan of all 177 save images

fields.name: text_4110
fields.meaning: Text WIZ-S, written once on a fresh memory; purpose not resolved
fields.evidence: code 2000:4CF7 copies from ROM 2000:4D12; no readers found

fields.name: unknown_4116
fields.meaning: Unknown; zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: scan of all 177 save images

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: 32-bit sum of all bytes 0x2FC2-0x4151. Rewritten after every roster/setting change; checked at power-on
fields.evidence: code 2000:4D18 (sum) / 2000:4D3F (store); recomputed over all 177 saves: every valid image matches

fields.name: work_area_mid
fields.meaning: Not save data: working space (scratch character record at 0x4156, temple candidate list at 0x41C5, encounter list at 0x4225)
fields.evidence: outside checked ranges; code 2000:20A2D, 3000:36589, 2000:123E

fields.name: backup
fields.meaning: Backup copy of 0x2FC2-0x4155 (records, settings and checksum). Made when START is chosen on the title screen; if the main copy fails its check but both signatures are good, the backup is copied back
fields.evidence: code 2000:4D57 (copy), 2000:4D80 (verify + restore); older/newer backup pairs seen in saves

fields.name: work_area_high
fields.meaning: Not save data (working space)
fields.evidence: outside checked ranges

fields.name: signature_2
fields.meaning: Fixed text 2000BANDAI/STING, checked at power-on
fields.evidence: code 2000:4A60 compares against ROM 2000:4B59; boot reads at 2000:4A84

fields.name: not_used
fields.meaning: The game does not keep its save in the console's internal memory; identical between a fresh boot and a full play session
fields.evidence: diff of boot vs played internal-EEPROM images
